name: Google
description: Product, SWE, and behavioral loops emphasizing scalability and user impact.
question_pack: Tell me about a time you improved a system at scale.
How do you prioritize when user needs conflict with engineering cost?
Describe a mistake you made in production and how you fixed it.

name: Amazon
description: Leadership Principles–style behavioral and PM interviews.
question_pack: Give an example of diving deep to solve a customer problem.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a decision but committed.
Describe delivering results under a tight deadline.

name: Meta
description: Product sense, execution, and cross-functional influence.
question_pack: How would you grow engagement for a declining feature?
Tell me about shipping something fast that you later iterated on.
Describe influencing a team without direct authority.

name: Early-stage startup
description: Generalist interviews: ownership, scrappiness, learning velocity.
question_pack: Why this startup and role now?
Tell me about wearing multiple hats on a small team.
What would you build in your first 30 days?
